data.name: Co-reactive
data.description: Co-reactive GmbH is a climate-tech startup founded in 2024 as an RWTH Aachen spin-off, headquartered in Düsseldorf, developing a continuous CO2 mineralization process that converts CO2 together with olivine or metallurgical slags into CO2-negative supplementary cementitious materials. The company closed a €6.5 million seed round and is scaling from prototype to a 1,000-ton demonstration plant with plans for industrial pilot plants at the tens-of-thousands-of-tons scale.
